answer_1.quote: Simultaneous speech translation models ... can perform both Simul‑S2T and Simul‑S2S tasks within a unified end‑to‑end framework. ... In Simul‑S2T, its performance is on par with state‑of‑the‑art models. In Simul‑S2S, it significantly surpasses cascade Simul‑S2T + TTS baselines, achieving high‑quality simultaneous interpretation.

answer_2.quote: Translation quality is assessed using case‑sensitive detokenized BLEU ... while latency is measured by word‑level Average Lagging (AL). ... ASR‑BLEU ... BLASER 2.0 ... We also incorporate Average Proportion (AP), Differentiable Average Lagging (DAL) and Length Adaptive Average Lagging (LAAL) as metrics.
